journey.title: Ticking a checkbox inside the preferences dialog keeps it open
journey.goal: Space ticks the checkbox and the dialog stays open

functionalJourney.title: Open and close preferences with the pointer
functionalJourney.goal: The dialog opens and the close button dismisses it

guards.title: Done closes the preferences dialog from the keyboard
guards.goal: Activating Done dismisses the dialog and focus returns to the trigger

attempts.failure: Expected ',' or ']' after array element in JSON at position 1078 (line 11 column 34)

plan.root_cause: The modal's click handler closes the dialog for any click inside the overlay because it uses `closest` to find the close trigger, which matches the overlay ancestor for all descendant clicks. This causes the dialog to close when the checkbox receives a click event (triggered by Space key).
plan.repair_strategy: Modify the click handler to only close when the clicked element itself has the close trigger attribute (i.e., event.target === closeTarget), allowing clicks on the overlay background or close button to close, but not clicks on interactive elements inside the dialog.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Checkbox can be toggled via Space key without closing the dialog, preserving keyboard operability (WCAG 2.1.1) and focus management (WCAG 2.4.3).
functional_risks: Minimal; only changes click dismissal logic. Could affect closing when clicking on overlay if the overlay is not the direct target (but it is). Ensure close button still works.
verification_requirements: Run the existing journey test; ensure Space on checkbox toggles and dialog stays open.
Verify Tab traps focus inside the dialog.
Verify clicking overlay background closes the dialog.
Verify clicking close button closes the dialog.

Copy before verbatim from source_candidates.
